data_quality.notes: Real, currently active player -- confirmed via ESPN Argentina (dedicated profile piece), Wikipedia, Total Football Analysis (tactical scout report), BeSoccer and ceroacero.es. Born 3 Mar 2004 in Montevideo. Named in the 2025 Liga AUF Uruguaya Team of the Year and made his senior Uruguay debut on 9 Sep 2025 vs Chile after being the only domestic-league player called up by Bielsa. ESPN headline framed him as a player of interest to River Plate, though no fee/formal bid is reported in snippets. 2025 Apertura stats (2882 minutes, 1 goal, 1 assist) from Wikipedia/ESPN. Sources describe him variously as a right-back and a right winger (used in a wide, attacking right-sided role) -- entered as RW with RB as secondary.
